_note: grant-cases-from-application-to-settlement task 1.3 (openspec/changes/grant-cases-from-application-to-settlement): a case type that runs the grant chain says so as configuration (decision 182), so the case page can place its interim reports, evidence, settlement and recovery, and their header actions, by that flag rather than by the case type's name or folder. The subsidie package sets it. caseType moves to 1.51.0 (1.50.0 is tender-chain) so an existing instance re-imports the schema. A fragment per ADR-037.

grantChain.title: Runs the grant chain
grantChain.description: Whether a case of this type is a grant: its case page shows the decision and advance schedule, the interim reports, the evidence, the settlement and the recovery, with the actions to record and assess an interim report, settle and recover.
